name: @cognis/cli
description: A real client for cognis: gets actual reading through the actual pipeline

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test

cognis.optionalDependencyNote: @huggingface/transformers is optional because onnxruntime-node's postinstall downloads native binaries that fail in sandboxed, offline and some CI environments. Without it the CLI falls back to a lexical embedder and says so. Enable with: npm install @huggingface/transformers -w @cognis/cli
